create_MutoxClassifier: create a MutoxClassifier instance wrapping an underlying model for toxicity classification
build_MutoxConfig: build a MutoxConfig dataclass specifying the input embedding size for the classifier
run_MutoxClassifier_forward: run the MutoxClassifier forward pass on a torch.Tensor input to get classification output
register_mutox_architecture: register a new architecture configuration with the mutox_archs ArchitectureRegistry
review_MutoxClassifier: review the MutoxClassifier module that wraps a model for forwarding tensor inputs
